t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Kolo co Madrarango, uni ci asekekoni, ko hnei Buango hna puli nu thu bane carajewe du Buango, ne ahmani Buango, inu ci waamilu du Buango ri gula hawa ome, wenore kogo ke inu ri hudathien 'ore nene ri Buango, ka deko ke inu ri tadawaien 'ore aca ace ni Buango, ka deko se Makaze, ka Buango so 'ore thu thakui nu ri tadan 'ore tango, ne Buango 'ore ci wien kani Buango ko.
